signal: Trackforce launched an industry-first AI threat-detection partnership with Scylla, wiring AI video surveillance into security workforce workflows

email.body1:
Mikael, saw Trackforce wired Scylla's AI threat detection straight into security workforce workflows, an industry first.

A move like that opens more enterprise accounts than a team can cover one rep at a time, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Trackforce off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mikael, quick follow-up for Trackforce.

New capabilities usually raise enterprise expectations faster than a sales team can staff to chase them. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number until the gap shows up late in the quarter, and recovering it then is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your enterprise motion needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mikael, last bit of proof for Trackforce.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Trackforce's reply rate likely compares to similar enterprise software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mikael, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Bringing a new AI capability to market is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise sales motion? I'll tailor it to Trackforce either way.
